# Security & correctness audit — 2026-10-29

**Scope:** whole repository at `65bb3b7`: 19 migrations, the Next.js app, the service worker and the outbox.

**Method:** independent reviewer with a threat model covering privilege escalation, data leaks, ledger integrity, definer-function hygiene and the app layer. Every finding was reproduced against the test database. Repro scripts were kept outside the repo.

**Result:** 15 findings (14 confirmed, 1 plausible). **All 15 fixed** in migrations `20261029001000_audit_fixes.sql` and `20261029001050_audit_fix_functions.sql` (the latter generated by `scripts/db/gen_audit_fix_functions.py`), plus app changes.

**Regression tests:** suite 17, plus updated assertions in suites 02, 11 and 14. Suites 02, 11, 14 and 17 fail when the two fix migrations are removed; this was checked before committing. Suite 17 aborts at its first assertion in that check, so its later assertions were not individually confirmed to fail. Unit guards cover the service worker and the retry policy.

| # | Severity | Finding | Fix | Test |
|---|----------|---------|-----|------|
| 1 | High | Orders could be reserved and shipped from **quarantine/transit** warehouses (recalled lots to customers) | Table triggers: no reservation or `sale_issue` movement in quarantine, transit or inactive warehouses (`WAREHOUSE_NOT_SELLABLE`). Write-offs still allowed. | 17 |
| 2 | High | **Blocked/archived customers'** orders could still be submitted, approved, reserved | Trigger on order status: no advance for archived/blocked customers (`CUSTOMER_BLOCKED`). Cancel and reject still allowed. | 17 |
| 3 | Med-High | Adjustment limit bypassed by **splitting** into small adjustments | Limit applies to the day's cumulative unapproved quantity per user, warehouse and variant (Cairo day) | 17, 02 |
| 4 | Medium | `audit.audit_log` row images (`old_data`/`new_data`) readable by anyone with `audit.log.read`, bypassing every table's RLS (costs, phones, credit limits) | Column-level grant: metadata only. Row-image access is deferred to a future owner-only, scope-filtering function. | 17 |
| 5 | Medium | `sales.resolve_list_price` (definer, PUBLIC execute) revealed any customer's private price list | **Privilege sweep:** every internal definer function not needed by an RLS policy or view is revoked from clients. A test enforces it. | 17 |
| 6 | Medium | An approved "no customer location" exception **pinned the clinic at the rep's own fix**, letting a rep verify every later check-in from anywhere | No automatic pin. A `crm.customer_location.verify` holder sets the location. | 11 |
| 7 | Medium | A non-owner admin could **reactivate a suspended owner** | Owner-only for owners; nobody reactivates themselves | 17 |
| 8 | Medium | Any user could **forge security events** via `authz.log_security_event` | Covered by the privilege sweep | 17 |
| 9 | Medium | Service worker **cached authenticated pages**; offline, the next user on a shared device saw them | Navigations are never cached (offline page only). Cache version bump deletes old page caches. | unit `service-worker` |
| 10 | Low-Med | Multi-stage approvals allowed **one person to decide every stage** | Distinct approvers across stages (separation of duties) | 14 |
| 11 | Low-Med | `api.post_inventory_adjustment` callable directly, skipping validation and events | Revoked from clients; `api.request_inventory_adjustment` is the only path | 02 |
| 12 | Low | `visit_check_in` accepted **another rep's visit id** (could block their check-in) | Visit id must belong to the caller and customer | 17 |
| 13 | Low | Team-scoped admin read permissions acted as **company-wide** in some policies | Scope-aware policies (profiles, role assignments; audit/security require `all`) | 17 |
| 14 | Low | **Removing** a role permission had no ceiling | Same ceiling as granting, plus own-role check | 17 |
| 15 | Low (plausible) | App **auto-retried network failures**, which could double-apply a committed command | Only roll-back-certain SQLSTATEs are retried. Duplicate active role grants are impossible (unique index). | unit `errors`, 17 |

## Known and accepted (not fixed in this round)

| Item | Why it's accepted | Plan |
|------|-------------------|------|
| Reps can read lot-level stock balances, not only available quantity | Low sensitivity | Revisit with the Phase 3 stock UI |
| Credit exposure ignores open, uninvoiced orders | Matches the current spec | Decide with Finance (D-09 follow-up) |
| Concurrency and locking not exercised | Single-session tests cannot | Needs a multi-session test in CI |
| No Content-Security-Policy | — | **Resolved 2026-10-30:** per-request nonce CSP from `src/proxy.ts` and `src/lib/security-headers.ts`, plus a meta copy for the Android app (`docs/security/audit-2026-11-03.md` A-LM1, F1) |
| Row-image audit diffs have no reader | — | **Resolved 2026-10-30:** masked, logged, owner-only reader `api.audit_search` / `api.audit_record_history` (`20261103001100`, suite 44; masking hardened in `20261104000700`, suite 52) |

## Areas checked and found sound

- Every function uses `search_path = ''`. No dynamic SQL in commands, and approval conditions are treated as data only.
- Anonymous users have no access. Hooks and internal writers are revoked from clients.
- All views are `security_invoker`.
- The grant ceiling, owner protection and last-owner guard hold.
- Approval engine: self-approval, re-deciding, deciding beyond a limit and deciding out of scope are all blocked.
- Client prices are ignored. Reservations are all-or-nothing. The fulfilment idempotency key is bound to its order.
- Ledgers are append-only, and `reserved ≤ on_hand` is enforced.
- GPS-fix RLS holds.
- Outbox: payloads are hidden from admins, cron auth is constant-time, redirects are not followed.
- No open redirects. The invite flow checks permissions before using the service role. No XSS sinks.
